summary: Pinterest login must request only scopes Pinterest's OAuth docs list (never msot:write by default), let the user choose scopes (--scopes / PINTEREST_SCOPES / basic preset), and collect the client secret with hidden input whenever it is missing.
reason: Pinterest rejects msot:write as an invalid scope, failing every login; its token endpoint also requires the client secret, so silently falling through to a secret-less PKCE exchange fails with 401 and pasting the secret as a flag leaks it to the terminal.
validated_outcome: Live login against a trial-access app succeeded with the default scope set and a hidden-prompt secret; user-account get and boards list returned live data.
